name: Pythia
description: One local API call gives your agent the entire live state of the planet — every major world event at once, plus forecasts. 40+ free keyless feeds, runs entirely on Ollama. No cloud, no cost.  Keyless live feeds into one global view and forecasts what’s likely next. No cloud, no keys, no cost.  1d,1w,1m,1y predictions by Mirofish.
readme_summary: Pythia is a local, cost-free API that provides real-time global intelligence and future forecasts by fusing live world feeds with a swarm-intelligence prediction engine. It runs entirely on user hardware, offering a unified, machine-readable view of global events and their potential outcomes for agents and decision-making.
key_features: Real-time global intelligence feeds (news, conflict, weather, cyber, markets, etc.)
24-hour, weekly, monthly, and yearly forecasts
Runs entirely on local hardware (no cloud dependencies)
Keyless operation (no API keys required)
Cost-free usage
Fuses MiroFish (prediction engine) and Osiris (live globe) projects
Local LLM for generating forecasts and reasoning
Swarm intelligence for predictions with consensus and dissent
Includes regulatory and capital-flow feeds (SEC filings, insider trades)
primary_use_case: To provide agents and users with a comprehensive, real-time, and predictive understanding of global events and their potential future trajectories, all processed locally without ongoing costs.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient oracle figure, cloaked in swirling nebulae representing global data streams, stands at a crossroads. One hand points to a vibrant, real-time 3D globe displaying live events like storms and conflicts, while the other hand gestures towards a shimmering, translucent projection of future probabilities and trends. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets emanate from the globe and projection, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is set in a serene, minimalist chamber, bathed in soft, ethereal light, with the repository name 'PYTHIA' subtly inscribed on a pedestal. The style should be a detailed digital painting with a focus on conveying vast information and foresight through a clear, symbolic metaphor.

name: trail-mate
description: Trail Mate is an offline‑first handheld system for GPS navigation, LoRa communication, and real‑time team situational awareness in no‑network environments.
readme_summary: Trail Mate is a decentralized, offline-first system for secure communication and situational awareness in environments without network access. It prioritizes user control over identity, data, and connectivity, running on personal devices for navigation, team coordination, and data management.
key_features: Offline-first operation
Decentralized communication (Meshtastic, MeshCore, Reticulum)
Anonymous operation
On-device TAK capability for situational awareness
User-controlled identity and data storage
Offline maps and navigation
primary_use_case: Enabling reliable communication, navigation, and team situational awareness in off-grid or no-network environments, prioritizing user control and data sovereignty.
cover_image_prompt: A lone explorer standing on a remote mountain peak, holding a rugged, handheld device that projects a holographic map and team icons into the air. The device is connected via glowing, ethereal lines to other small, distant icons representing team members scattered across a stylized, off-grid landscape. Subtle digital particles emanate from the device, symbolizing data flow and communication. The background is a vast, star-filled night sky, emphasizing isolation and the need for self-sufficient connectivity. The overall mood is one of resilience and independence. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear, glowing elements and a sense of depth.

name: guardian-cli
description: Guardian is a production-ready AI-powered penetration testing automation CLI tool that leverages Google Gemini and LangChain to orchestrate intelligent, step-by-step penetration testing workflows while maintaining ethical hacking standards.
readme_summary: Guardian is an AI-powered penetration testing automation framework that integrates multiple AI providers and a wide array of security tools. It aims to deliver intelligent, adaptive security assessments with features like multi-agent debate triage and RAG-based knowledge bases to reduce false positives and improve efficiency.
key_features: Multi-Provider AI Intelligence (7+ providers including local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)
Plugin Provider Contract for easy third-party integration
Multi-Agent Architecture with specialized roles and debate triage
Vision-LLM Visual Triage for image-grounded analysis
RAG Knowledge Base for grounded retrieval over security feeds
Learned Tool Selection with offline ranker
Adaptive Testing that adjusts tactics based on findings
Extensive Tool Arsenal with 50+ integrated security tools across 10+ categories (Network, Web Recon, Vuln Scanning, Cloud, SAST, API Fuzzers, etc.)
primary_use_case: Automating and enhancing penetration testing workflows with AI intelligence and a comprehensive suite of security tools.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, robotic owl perched on a network server rack, its eyes glowing with AI energy. It meticulously examines a stream of digital data flowing from various security tools (represented by small, distinct icons like a lock, a magnifying glass, and a shield). The owl uses its advanced vision to identify and highlight potential threats within the data stream, which are then neatly categorized and presented on a holographic display. Subtle code snippets and security vulnerability icons float around the scene, indicating the repository's technical nature. The overall mood is one of vigilant intelligence and sophisticated automation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, futuristic color palette and glowing accents.

name: Raven
description: Document chat app for macOS / iOS. Upload files, ask questions. Everything runs locally on your Mac / iPhone.
readme_summary: Raven is a privacy-focused AI assistant app for macOS and iOS that allows users to upload documents and ask questions. It leverages Apple's on-device Foundation Models for all processing, ensuring data remains local and no internet connection is required for its core AI features.
key_features: Text extraction from images, PDFs, audio, and video files
Audio transcription and video text extraction
Smart Q&A and contextual content analysis
Local AI processing using Apple Foundation Models
Project creation and file organization
Privacy-first, all data stays on-device
primary_use_case: To provide users with a secure, on-device AI assistant for querying and summarizing personal documents on macOS and iOS.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, friendly owl perched on a stack of diverse documents (PDFs, images, audio tapes). The owl is holding a glowing magnifying glass over one document, and from the magnifying glass, a stream of clear, concise text bubbles and insightful question marks are flowing upwards. Subtle digital particles and faint UI elements of a chat interface are visible around the owl, hinting at the AI's interaction. The background is a clean, modern desk with a hint of a macOS or iOS interface. The overall mood is intelligent, secure, and accessible. Style: 3D isometric illustration with soft, natural lighting and a calming color palette.

name: likec4
description: Visualize, collaborate, and evolve the software architecture with always actual and live diagrams from your code
readme_summary: LikeC4 is a tool that generates software architecture diagrams directly from code, inspired by the C4 model. It allows for visualization, collaboration, and evolution of architecture by treating it as code, offering flexibility in defining custom notations and element types.
key_features: Architecture as code
Generates diagrams from code
Inspired by C4 Model and Structurizr DSL
Customizable notation, element types, and nesting levels
Live preview with CLI
VSCode extension for integrated development
primary_use_case: To automatically generate and maintain up-to-date software architecture diagrams directly from source code, enabling better visualization and collaboration on architectural designs.
cover_image_prompt: A master architect, depicted as a sculptor, standing in a digital workshop. They are meticulously carving intricate, glowing blueprints from raw blocks of code. As the sculptor chips away, the code transforms into a clear, multi-layered 3D model of a software system, complete with interconnected components and data flows. Subtle UI elements showing the 'likec4' logo and code snippets are visible on a nearby workbench. The overall scene is clean, modern, and uses a vibrant, futuristic color palette with soft, ambient lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing the transformation of abstract code into a tangible, understandable architecture.
